name: Claude Code 2.1.257-259 — Fable 5.1 Default, Containment Escape, Org MCP, GitLab
hook: Three releases in two days rewired the core. 2.1.257 (Sep 1) made Fable 5.1 the new default Fable model ($0.25/Mtok cache reads), added `timeFormat`/`timeZone` display settings, and introduced a Containment Escape rule in auto mode — cloud metadata-credential fetches, egress evasion, and cross-tenant reach are no longer auto-approved. 2.1.259 (Sep 2) added `managedMcpServers`, letting organizations push HTTP/SSE MCP servers to all users without individual setup; `--permission-prompts none` for headless hosts; and GitLab MR recognition. Critical concurrent-session bug fixed: multiple sessions were silently reverting each other's `~/.claude.json` changes.
